description: This file contains unit tests for the CloudStore plugin, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests various JSON-RPC methods such as getValue, setValue, deleteKey, deleteNamespace, and their interactions with mocked implementations of CloudStore and related classes.

classes.name: ACloudStore
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up CloudStore plugin tests with mock services.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Mocked implementation of CloudStore used within individual test cases to simulate behavior.
